# Hospitals

This folder catalogs hospitals that serve as major institutional hubs for psychiatric care and ADHD treatment in Denmark. It specifically covers the psychiatric division of Aarhus University Hospital and its specialized child and adolescent department, detailing their organizational structure, key medical staff, and their roles in navigating systemic challenges within Region Midtjylland's healthcare landscape.

## Pages

- [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|"Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien"]] — The overarching psychiatric center housing both child/youth and adult psychiatric services, employing key figures in Danish ADHD treatment and national steering groups.
- [[bua|Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA)]] — A specialized child and adolescent psychiatric department operating under Aarhus University Hospital, functioning as a central clinical reference center for ADHD assessment and treatment in children and youth.
